records.title: Daevanion board
records.body:
Five talent boards: Nezekan (when you complete the story quest "Urgent Pursuit", Lv 13), Zikel (Lv 20), Vaizel (Lv 30), Triniel (Lv 40) and Azphel (Lv 45). You use Daevanion Crystals from the Cube (2 per Sealed Dungeon, 1 per regional quest) to add crystals to the board, then buy nodes connected to the free centre.

Grey nodes are stats (1 crystal). Blue nodes add +1 level to an active skill (3 crystals), green nodes to a passive (2 crystals); some passives have two nodes on a board. Orange corner nodes cost 4 and give +1.5% of a big stat. Azphel has no skill nodes and uses its own Azphel crystals (from battleground fragments or Abyss Points) instead.

Like a paragon board: a skill node is a permanent +1 to that skill, on top of the levels you buy with Skill Points (from your game). Board levels count toward a skill's specialty slots (seen in your game). Not documented: whether board levels can push a skill past 10, and the reset cost.
records.credit: Metabot Daevanion guide and Gladiator boards (the same grid as the Assassin's), Metaroad Assassin boards, AION2HUB, your game

records.title: How it plays
records.body:
• The loop: both sources build one macro line with Overhead Slam above Rending Blow, and hold its key together with left click (Keen Strike).
  • By hand: Leaping Slam and your stigmas. A macro would spend buffs on trash and fire only a charged skill's first stage.
records.credit: daevaguides macro guide and aion2turkiye's Gladiator page

records.title: Stigma
records.body: Extra skills that go into special slots, separate from your normal skills. Slots open at 22, 27, 32 and 37, four in total. Level 22's slot unlocks through the quest "The One Who Hears the Voice." Every stigma can be learned from then on, and any stigma fits any slot.

records.title: Where Skill Points come from
records.body:
Two sources: character levels grant points automatically, and Wisdom Stone items (from Sealed Dungeons, regional quests and drops) give 1 point each, but only once you use them from the Cube.

The skill window's points breakdown lists both sources under "Points Earned", and what you've spent under "Points Used" (shown as Mastery). Earned minus used is what you can spend now.

Skills don't level up by themselves: you spend points, and each skill level also needs a character level. Skill level L opens at the level you learned the skill + 3 × (L − 2). Rending Blow, learned at Lv 1, reaches skill level 5 at Lv 10. Each level costs 1 point (levels 2–4), 2 points (5–7) or 4 points (8–10).

Daevanion Crystals work the same way: use them from the Cube to add crystals to the board.
records.credit: Metabot item and skill pages; points breakdown and skill level gates confirmed in game
